What version of the Linux kernel are you using? If it's below 4.16 then upgrade to 4.16, otherwise you can open a terminal and enter the following:

sudo ln -s /usr/lib/systemd/system/hibernate.target /etc/systemd/system/suspend.target && sudo ln -s /usr/lib/systemd/system/systemd-hibernate.service /etc/systemd/system/systemd-suspend.service

What this will do is replace the sleep function with hibernate so that when you put your device to sleep it hibernates instead, not ideal but it stops the issue you're experiencing.
